items.title: Gokul hikes buffalo milk price by ₹6, cow milk by ₹4; farmers unhappy
items.rss_summary: The Kolhapur District Cooperative Milk Producers' Union, popularly known as Gokul Milk Union, has decided to increase the selling price of buffalo milk by Rs 6 per litre and cow milk by Rs 4 per litre with immediate effect, its chairman Rajesh Patil said on Saturday. The decision was taken unanimously by all 25 directors due to the drought situation and the difficulties faced by farmers, Patil, a former MLA, said. The union has also decided to raise the procurement rates paid to milk producers by Rs 3 per litre for buffalo milk and Rs 2 per litre for cow milk, he said, adding that this hike was "historic". "The revised rates will come into effect from November 21 and remain applicable for around 131 days, till March. The situation will be reviewed every month, and the board will take further decisions depending on the circumstances," Patil said. He said milk availability was likely to decline significantly across Maharashtra, including Kolhapur district, and the union would have to
items.hinglish_title: Gokul Ne Badhaye Doodh Ke Daam, Bhains Ka Doodh ₹6 Aur Gaye Ka ₹4 Hua Mehenga
items.explanation: Gokul Milk Union ne bhains ke doodh ki selling price mein ₹6 prati litre aur gaye ke doodh mein ₹4 prati litre ki badtari ki hai. Chairman Rajesh Patil ke mutabik, sookhe ki sthiti aur kisano ki mushkilon ko dekhte hue sabhi 25 directors ne milkar ye faisla liya hai. Iske alawa, doodh utpadako ke liye procurement rates mein bhi bhains ke doodh par ₹3 aur gaye ke doodh par ₹2 prati litre ki badtari ki gayi hai. Naye daam 21 November se lagoo hokar March tak lagbhag 131 dino tak laagu rahenge.

items.title: Hero FinCorp aims to double loan disbursements over next two quarters
items.rss_summary: Hero FinCorp aims to double its loan disbursement volumes over the next two quarters, after disbursing over 4.80 lakh loans across northern India between January and September this year. Financial services company Hero FinCorp Ltd is a division of two-wheeler manufacturer Hero MotoCorp. The company's growth plans will be supported by its diversified lending portfolio, distribution network and artificial intelligence-led underwriting capabilities, according to a statement. The non-banking financial company caters to diverse financing needs through a comprehensive portfolio of retail, MSME and corporate lending solutions. "Over 4.8 lakh households and businesses across seven states have chosen us this year for a two-wheeler, a car, a personal loan, working capital or a loan against property. "We aim to double our growth in the region over the next two quarters while keeping the customer's trust at the centre of every decision we make," Hero FinCorp's spokesperson said.
items.hinglish_title: Hero FinCorp Agle Do Quarters Mein Loan Disbursement Double Karne Ki Taiyari Mein

Company ne is saal January se September ke dauran northern India mein 4.80 lakh se zyada loans baante hain. Is plan ko unke diversified portfolio, distribution network aur AI-led underwriting system se support milega. Company retail, MSME aur corporate sectors ki financing zaroorato ko poora karti hai.

Speaking to reporters after Prime Minister Narendra Modi's programme at IIT Kharagpur, Majumdar said the BJP government was committed to bringing industry to Singur and that the proposed facility would manufacture heavy vehicles. "We want to bring industry back to Singur. Our chief minister has also said so. I am reiterating today that Ashok Leyland is coming to Singur. It will set up a truck manufacturing plant, and work will begin soon," the Union minister of state for education said. items.title: GST Network adds metro rail as fifth mode of transport in e-way bill system
items.rss_summary: The GST Network (GSTN) has added metro rail as a new mode of transport in the e-way bill system. Currently, the facility has also been released in the "Sandbox environment" for API users to test and make necessary changes to their systems. Its roll-out in the live API environment will be announced separately, GSTN, which manages the IT backbone of Goods and Services Tax, said. The facility follows a government notification dated October 26. With this addition, the e-way bill system now has five modes of transport: Road, Rail, Air, Ship and Metro Rail. Under the Goods and Services Tax (GST), the e-way bill is mandatory for transiting goods valued at Rs 50,000 and above, both inter- and intra-state. GSTN, in an advisory issued on November 20, said the new option is available to web users for generating e-way bills and updating transport details. items.hinglish_title: E-Way Bill System Mein Metro Rail Bana Transport Ka 5th Mode
items.explanation: GST Network (GSTN) ne e-way bill system mein ab Metro Rail ko naye transport mode ke roop mein shamil kiya hai. Is naye jod ke baad system mein Road, Rail, Air, Ship aur Metro Rail samet kul paanch modes ho gaye hain. Ye facility abhi API users ke liye sandbox environment mein testing ke liye available hai, jabki web users isse transport details update kar sakte hain. GST ke tehat ₹50,000 ya usse zyada ke saaman ke transit par e-way bill mandatory hota hai.

items.title: Adani Energy to supply 2,500 MW renewable energy to West Bengal discom
items.rss_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd (AESL) on Saturday said its wholly-owned subsidiary Powerpulse Trading Solutions Ltd (PTSL) has bagged a project to supply up to 2,500 MW of renewable energy to West Bengal discom WBSEDCL for 25 years. The Letter of Award (LoA) from West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Co Ltd (WBSEDCL) is for the supply of 1,750 MW of renewable energy round-the-clock for a period of 25 years. The LoA provides a 750 MW green shoe option, which, upon exercise, would take the aggregate contracted capacity to 2,500 MW, AESL said in a statement. The award follows a competitive bidding process. Power supply is scheduled to begin from July 1, 2028, for 1,750 MW capacity and from April 1, 2029, for 750 MW, once the green shoe option is exercised, it said "Round-the-clock renewable power will be critical to India's energy transition, combining the sustainability of renewables and optimising transmission systems usage. Shuruat mein 1,750 MW round-the-clock power supply ke liye award mila hai, jisme 750 MW ka green shoe option bhi shamil hai. Is 1,750 MW capacity ke liye supply 1 July 2028 se shuru hone ka schedule hai. Green shoe option exercise hone par bachi hui 750 MW ki supply 1 April 2029 se shuru hogi.

items.hinglish_title: Sensex 898 Points Chadha, Bank Shares Aur Foreign Inflows Se Sahare Nifty 25,800 Par
items.explanation: Stock market me bhari tezi aayi jisme Sensex 898 points badha aur Nifty ne 25,800 ka aakda fir chhu liya. Banking stocks aur foreign capital inflows ne bazaar ko oopar kheenchne me madad ki. Zyada details ke liye original report dekhein.
